svg.title: Gap map: musicLibrary and cross-project
svg.desc: 9 gaps drawn as red dashed edges between the parts they affect, each badge numbered G1… and its contract listed below; proposed modules are dashed brand cards linked to the gaps they close.

g.aria-label: M1 Set exchange closes G2
g.title: M1 Set exchange closes G2

g.aria-label: M2 Play-history import closes G4
g.title: M2 Play-history import closes G4

g.aria-label: M3 Transition feed closes G5
g.title: M3 Transition feed closes G5

g.aria-label: G6 Second-source BPM and key are discarded – contract: ledger track bpm_source, key_source (severity critical, effort S)
g.title: G6 Second-source BPM and key are discarded – contract: ledger track bpm_source, key_source (severity critical, effort S)

g.aria-label: G4 Rekordbox play history and overrides do not feed back automatically – contract: rekordbox DJ_PLAYLISTS TRACK{Location, Artist, Name, PlayCount, LastPlayed, DateAdded} -> ledger local_path, appearances (severity medium, effort S)
g.title: G4 Rekordbox play history and overrides do not feed back automatically – contract: rekordbox DJ_PLAYLISTS TRACK{Location, Artist, Name, PlayCount, LastPlayed, DateAdded} -> ledger local_path, appearances (severity medium, effort S)

g.aria-label: G2 Saved-set shape is no longer shared between the two Set Builders – contract: naarm.saved-set.v2 (severity critical, effort M)
g.title: G2 Saved-set shape is no longer shared between the two Set Builders – contract: naarm.saved-set.v2 (severity critical, effort M)

g.aria-label: G3 JohnCourse.json and kiki.json are written but never consumed – contract: songnodes.setlists.v1 -> TracklistImportRequest (severity critical, effort M)
g.title: G3 JohnCourse.json and kiki.json are written but never consumed – contract: songnodes.setlists.v1 -> TracklistImportRequest (severity critical, effort M)

g.aria-label: G9 songnodes drops pipeline fields on ingest – contract: LibraryTrack parity between library.json and /api/v1/library/search (severity medium, effort S)
g.title: G9 songnodes drops pipeline fields on ingest – contract: LibraryTrack parity between library.json and /api/v1/library/search (severity medium, effort S)

g.aria-label: G1 README contract names a songnodes script that no longer exists – contract: library.json v1 (build_db.export_artifact_json) -> POST /api/v1/library/ingest, Idempotency-Key import-<md5> (severity medium, effort M)
g.title: G1 README contract names a songnodes script that no longer exists – contract: library.json v1 (build_db.export_artifact_json) -> POST /api/v1/library/ingest, Idempotency-Key import-<md5> (severity medium, effort M)

g.aria-label: G8 TIDAL login collides with songnodes on 127.0.0.1:3006 – contract: TIDAL redirect per client; shared set->playlist map (severity medium, effort M)
g.title: G8 TIDAL login collides with songnodes on 127.0.0.1:3006 – contract: TIDAL redirect per client; shared set->playlist map (severity medium, effort M)

g.aria-label: G5 songnodes proven transitions never inform musicLibrary set building – contract: library.json tracks[].nx: [{id, n}] (severity medium, effort M)
g.title: G5 songnodes proven transitions never inform musicLibrary set building – contract: library.json tracks[].nx: [{id, n}] (severity medium, effort M)

g.aria-label: G7 Outputs with no reader – contract: review_queue.csv energy_score_override -> overrides (severity critical, effort S)
g.title: G7 Outputs with no reader – contract: review_queue.csv energy_score_override -> overrides (severity critical, effort S)

g.aria-label: M1 Set exchange (proposed module): Reads either saved-set shape and writes one versioned `songnodes.saved-set/2` document (name, shape, minutes, tracks[{isrc, tidal_id, ledger_id, tgt}], tidal) to musicLibrary inbox/artifact_sets.json, rejecting rows it cannot map.
g.title: M1 Set exchange (proposed module): Reads either saved-set shape and writes one versioned `songnodes.saved-set/2` document (name, shape, minutes, tracks[{isrc, tidal_id, ledger_id, tgt}], tidal) to musicLibrary inbox/artifact_sets.json, rejecting rows it cannot map.

g.aria-label: M2 Play-history import (proposed module): Matches plays to ledger tracks by local_path then ISRC, appends `play` events to the ledger and writes rotation evidence that calibrate.py reads.
g.title: M2 Play-history import (proposed module): Matches plays to ledger tracks by local_path then ISRC, appends `play` events to the ledger and writes rotation evidence that calibrate.py reads.

g.aria-label: M3 Transition feed (proposed module): Publishes `songnodes.transitions/1` (pairs of ISRCs with counts) beside library.json so both Set Builders can rank spares by proven pairings.
g.title: M3 Transition feed (proposed module): Publishes `songnodes.transitions/1` (pairs of ISRCs with counts) beside library.json so both Set Builders can rank spares by proven pairings.

g.title: G6 contract: ledger track bpm_source, key_source

g.aria-label: G9 contract: LibraryTrack parity between library.json and /api/v1/library/search
g.title: G9 contract: LibraryTrack parity between library.json and /api/v1/library/search
